title.value: AN ACT concerning perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances in firefighting foam and supplementing Title 56 of the Revised Statutes.
title.provenance: "AN ACT concerning  perfluoroalkyl  and  polyfluoroalkyl  substances in  firefighting  foam  and  supplementing  Title  56  of  the  Revised Statutes."

pfas_definition.provenance: "'Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances' or 'PFAS' means substances that include any member of the class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom."

type.provenance: "Prohibits sale, manufacture,  distribution,  and  use  of  firefighting foam containing intentionally added perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances."

date.provenance: "Beginning two years after the effective date of this act"

who.provenance: "no person shall use,  or  shall  sell,  offer  for  sale,  manufacture,  or distribute for sale or use"

action.provenance: "no person shall use,  or  shall  sell,  offer  for  sale,  manufacture,  or distribute for sale or use"

products.provenance: "class B firefighting foam containing intentionally added PFAS"

value: Sale, manufacture, distribution, or use of class B firefighting foam for which the inclusion of PFAS is required by federal law, or by a rule or regulation adopted pursuant thereto, including, but not limited to, 14 C.F.R. s.139.317.
exceptions.provenance: "Subsection a. of this section shall not apply to the sale, manufacture, distribution, or use of class B firefighting foam for which the inclusion of PFAS is required by federal law, or by a rule or regulation adopted pursuant thereto, including, but not limited to, 14 C.F.R. s.139.317."

intentionally_added.provenance: "'Intentionally added PFAS' means PFAS added to a product or one of the product's components to provide a specific characteristic, appearance, or quality or to perform a specific function. 'Intentionally added PFAS' also includes any degradation byproducts of PFAS."
